records.name: Angry Shout
records.effect: Fierce yell that dominates the area and recovers Ki.

records.name: Headshot
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 69 - God of Destruction and His Master
records.effect: A close-range forehead flick that launches the opponent.

records.name: Hyper Movement
records.effect: Teleports to the opponent and attacks; after knockback it can intercept their landing position.

records.name: Time Skip/Tremor Pulse
records.effect: Teleports behind the opponent and kicks; directional input moves the user in front instead; unblockable.

notes: Angry Shout and Headshot are character-only in the current Evasive catalog because no Future Warrior acquisition is listed there. Hyper Movement and Time Skip/Tremor Pulse explicitly have Future Warrior acquisition, so they are CaC-usable. Hyper Movement is a TP Medal Shop acquisition, while Time Skip/Tremor Pulse is learned through Hit training.
